posts.title: Ama and Joel, The Mount Without
posts.content:
Ama and Joel wanted West African and Spanish food on the same table for 140 people in a church with a tiny kitchen.

Venue

The Mount Without, St Michael's Hill

Guests

140, plus 12 crew

Format

Family-style feast in three waves

Staff

11 on the day

Season

August

What went out

Flatbreads, whipped feta, chilli honey

Jollof paella in two 90 cm pans

Suya-spiced lamb, pickled onions

Six burnt Basque cheesecakes

The jollof paella was the talk of the night. My uncles went back three times.

Ama, August 2026

What we would do differently

Bring a third pan. The vegetable one went first.

Who else was there

Planner

Themselves, with a spreadsheet

Venue

The Mount Without

Photos

Tola Ade
posts.excerpt: The Mount Without, 140 guests, family-style feast in three waves. Two 90 cm paella pans and six burnt cheesecakes.

posts.title: Night shoot, Avonmouth docks
posts.content:
Six weeks of night shoots, 85 crew, hot food at 1am, and a production manager who had been let down twice.

Venue

Unit 12, Avonmouth docks

Guests

85 crew a night

Format

Hot buffet from a trailer kitchen

Staff

4 per shift

Season

March and April

What went out

Breakfast baps at call time

Tacos on Thursdays, curry on Mondays

Soup every night

A 3am tray of brownies

Six weeks and nobody complained about the food once, which has never happened.

Sian, production manager, April 2026

What we would do differently

Order more soup cups. We ran out twice.

Who else was there

Production

Harbour Light Films

Location

Avonmouth docks

Trailer

Hired from Mobile Kitchens Bristol
posts.excerpt: Six weeks of night shoots, 85 crew, hot food at 1am. Taco Thursdays became a scheduling requirement.

posts.title: Harbourside architects, Friday lunches
posts.content:
A standing Friday lunch for a studio of 24 people who all have opinions about coleslaw.

Venue

An architects' studio on Wapping Road

Guests

24 every Friday

Format

Sharing platters at 12:15

Staff

1 driver

Season

All year

What went out

Sourdough sandwiches, four fillings

Three salads, one always with grains

A tray of cookies

We schedule meetings around it.

Priya, studio manager, June 2026

What we would do differently

Put the coleslaw in a separate tub so the anti-coleslaw faction can ignore it.

Who else was there

Client

Wapping Wharf Architects

Delivery

Every Friday since January
posts.excerpt: Friday lunch for 24 people, every week since January. Sourdough sandwiches, three salads, and a running argument about coleslaw.

posts.title: A 60th in a Clifton kitchen
posts.content:
A 60th birthday dinner for 22 in a family kitchen with an oven smaller than we were told.

Venue

A house on Royal York Crescent

Guests

22

Format

Plated starter, family-style main

Staff

2 staff and Femi

Season

November

What went out

Crab on toast

Roast chicken with garlic, lemon and thyme

Crispy potatoes, three trays

Sticky toffee pudding

We did no washing up. That was the whole present.

Marion, November 2025

What we would do differently

Ask for a photo of the oven. We now always do.

Who else was there

Host

Marion's children

Wine

Averys, Park Street
posts.excerpt: Dinner for 22 in a family kitchen in Clifton. Roast chicken, too many potatoes, and the washing up done by 11.

posts.title: Rosie and Dan, Arnos Vale
posts.content:
Rosie and Dan wanted food people would talk about, for 190 guests, half of them vegan, on the hottest day of June.

Venue

Arnos Vale, the Spielman Centre

Guests

190

Format

Mezze, then sharing mains

Staff

14 on the day

Season

June

What went out

Mezze boards, three dips, flatbread

Slow lamb shoulder, or roast squash with the same dressing

Bitter leaves, orange, hazelnuts

Rhubarb crumble in trays

The vegan platters went faster than the lamb, which nobody saw coming.

Rosie, June 2026

What we would do differently

Bake more flatbread. We ran out at 7:40pm.

Who else was there

Planner

Hattie Moss Weddings

Flowers

Wild Bunch, Stokes Croft

Photos

Kiran Bhatt
posts.excerpt: Arnos Vale, 190 guests, mezze to start and lamb shoulders to share. The vegan version went faster than the lamb.

posts.title: Film wrap party, Paintworks
posts.content:
A wrap party for 120 crew in a yard with no kitchen, two grills and a queue.

Venue

Paintworks yard, Arnos Vale

Guests

120

Format

Street food from two grills

Staff

6 plus the grill

Season

September

What went out

Jerk chicken buns, pineapple hot sauce

Halloumi and pepper skewers

Charred corn, lime butter

Doughnuts from Hart's

Best wrap food I have had in fifteen years of wraps.

Dev, first AD, September 2025

What we would do differently

Two grills was one too few. It is three next time.

Who else was there

Production

Harbour Light Films

Venue

Paintworks
posts.excerpt: Wrap party for 120 crew with two charcoal grills in the yard and a queue for the jerk chicken buns.

posts.title: Charity board breakfast
posts.content:
Breakfast for 30 trustees at 8am, on a charity budget, before a long meeting.

Venue

A church hall in Redland

Guests

30

Format

Breakfast buffet

Staff

2

Season

October

What went out

Berry and cinnamon swirl

Yoghurt pots with granola

Fruit

Coffee in an urn

The swirl disappeared before the minutes were approved.

Jo, chair of trustees, October 2025

What we would do differently

Bring a second urn. Trustees drink a lot of coffee.

Who else was there

Client

Redland Community Trust
posts.excerpt: Breakfast for 30 trustees at 8am in Redland. Pastries, fruit and a very strong urn of coffee.

posts.title: Garden birthday, 40 guests
posts.content:
A garden birthday for 40 with one gazebo, one outside tap and a forecast of rain at nine.

Venue

A back garden in Totterdown

Guests

40

Format

Canapés, sharing supper, cheese late

Staff

3

Season

July

What went out

Five canapés, two each

Flatbreads, lamb, potatoes, leaves

Cheese board with oat crackers and chutney

It rained, we all ate cheese in the kitchen, it was the best bit.

Sam, July 2026

What we would do differently

Bring the second gazebo even when the forecast is good.

Who else was there

Host

Sam and Chris

Gazebo

Borrowed from next door
posts.excerpt: A garden in Totterdown, 40 guests, one gazebo and a cheese board that lasted until midnight.
